notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l002: Ным II all/entirely, exact sleep formula in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/ным/. Not damp bedding.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l007: Child concealed against body, no invented specific bag or garment.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l013: Brass thimbles describe skilled women; not supernatural Jeztyrnak.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l015: Sixty wives, fourteen at marriage, and repeated tiny-child betrothal images retained without normalizing ages.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l017: Оолуккан in praise context excelling/standing out, provisional rather than literal intoxication.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l023: Икелүү equals никелүү lawfully married, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/ике/. Ак purity/lawfulness in union, not literal white object.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l025: Printed reaching forty conflicts with eighty-four in848. Retained rather than silently amended; subject may be wife or passage may be formulaically inconsistent.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l027: Куу баштык childlessness, not baldness in this context.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l032: Akbaltay announces his wife bore son; preceding secretly brought child retained, not independent narrative verification of birth.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l034: Ноот көл reservoir/artificial lake sense same edition glossary1841:l023–024. Broth hyperbole, not proper lake Noot.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l035: Ninety slaughtered animals unspecified here, followed by1000camels; no invented species for ninety.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l038: Ар camels as prior corpus; preceding fangs/lips describe beasts.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l041: Санжыргалуу splendid/renowned context https://el-sozduk.kg/САНЖЫРГАЛУУ/, дүң resounding celebration.
notes.manas-2010:p0847:b001:l042: Санат distinction/display of worth, not a census, provisional noun force.
notes.manas-2010:p0848:b001:l004: All livestock slaughtered hyperbole retained despite further gifts.
notes.manas-2010:p0848:b001:l009: Cradle-strap blessing literal naming/birth congratulation, not added instructions.
notes.manas-2010:p0848:b001:l011: Бегилик honor gift, Yudakhin exact mare/nine formula https://el-sozduk.kg/?lfrom=ru&lto=kg&page=main&word=Беги.
notes.manas-2010:p0848:b001:l013: Сүйүнчү customary good-news reward, distinguishes preceding honor gift.
notes.manas-2010:p0848:b001:l020: Акка моюн буруу can imply death/submission to God; here speaker remains alive and announces child, so turned toward God chosen provisionally, no actual death asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0848:b001:l024: Death-door child idiom of long-awaited old-age child, repeated, not resurrected father.
notes.manas-2010:p0848:b001:l032: Sixty gifts led by horse, no assumption all60horses.
notes.manas-2010:p0849:b001:l004: White/black beards designate older and younger adult groups, nextstage youths. Repetition retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0849:b001:l012: Купта north, established corpus lexical check; distinguished explicit qibla849:l026.
notes.manas-2010:p0849:b001:l016: Printed backside with ablution retained without euphemistic omission; ritual washing, not scatological joke invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0849:b001:l019: Khizir explicit identity, canonical name; age90literal.
notes.manas-2010:p0849:b001:l030: Child poised as if apportioning inheritance, explicit simile retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0849:b001:l031: Дубана holy wanderer/dervish, not a new personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p0849:b001:l036: Printed өлчөөн measure/assessment withweighingchildcontext; both weighing and looking retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0849:b001:l042: Ninety thousand speared enemies in heroic naming wish, not accomplished death count.
